description: Dependency updates for Panoptes (ADR-0006). One pull request at a time, weekly, nothing automerges.

customManagers.description: Container image pins held as string defaults in Terraform variables. The panoptes-gateway image also matches and is disabled in packageRules: it is this repository's own release.

packageRules.description: Commit scope for GitHub Actions and pre-commit hook revisions.
Commit scope for Terraform providers, the tflint ruleset and image pins in Terraform variables.
Commit scope for the gateway image base and the exit-path Compose stack.
Group non-major GitHub Actions updates into one pull request.
A Terraform provider major can change resource schemas: raise it only when approved on the dashboard, and flag it for a read of terraform plan.
panoptes-gateway is this repository's own image, built by gateway-image.yml and pinned by hand in iac/azure/variables.tf.
